correctness.rationale: Mod-2 support of odd closed token walk is nonempty odd Eulerian graph. At length g the projected support is one base g-cycle, each edge exactly once; flow forces one cyclic direction. Each permutation of edge move times uniquely yields the occupied set by cyclic descents, and counted cycles are simple. Cyclic Eulerian identity and start-point quotient prove formula. Independent tests: 39 base instances, 126 token cases.
